zh-cn.title: 【供应链】一笔需求订单为什么没满足？
zh-cn.summary: 从计划版本对比开始，沿 BOM 逐层查看结存和产线负荷，分清一笔缺口是缺物料，还是缺产能。

en.title: Why was a demand order left unfulfilled?
en.summary: Compare planning versions, then trace inventory and line loads through the BOM to distinguish material shortages from capacity constraints.

zh-cn.title: 【供应链】APS系统只需运行20分钟，为什么生产计划还要忙一周？
zh-cn.summary: 跟着一版周计划从需求确认走到工单下发，看看时间花在了哪些数据核对、缺口评审和人工调整上。

en.title: APS takes 20 minutes. Why does planning still take a week?
en.summary: Follow a weekly plan from demand confirmation to work-order release, including data preparation, shortage reviews, and manual adjustments.
